# deed_integration (Resource)

A Deed telemetry integration: a backend that bindings (`deed_telemetry_binding`) query — `prometheus` (Prometheus, Mimir, VictoriaMetrics, or a Grafana data-source proxy URL), `loki`, `grafana` (links and search), `natsmon` or `opensearch`. Installation-wide; requires an installation `admin` token. See Deed's docs/TELEMETRY.md for each adapter's configuration.

Credentials go in `secrets_wo`, a **write-only** argument (Terraform 1.11+): sent to Deed, never stored in state or plan. Change `secrets_wo_version` to send new values.

~> Deleting an integration deletes its bindings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Prometheus through Grafana's data-source proxy, with a Grafana service-account token (Viewer).
resource "deed_integration" "prometheus" {
  name    = "prometheus"
  adapter = "prometheus"
  config = jsonencode({
    url         = "https://grafana.example.com/api/datasources/proxy/uid/prometheus"
    allow_cidrs = ["192.168.0.7/32"] # grafana.example.com resolves to a LAN address
  })
  secrets_wo         = { token = var.grafana_token }
  secrets_wo_version = 1
}

resource "deed_integration" "loki" {
  name    = "loki"
  adapter = "loki"
  config = jsonencode({
    url         = "https://grafana.example.com/api/datasources/proxy/uid/loki"
    allow_cidrs = ["192.168.0.7/32"]
  })
  secrets_wo         = { token = var.grafana_token }
  secrets_wo_version = 1
}

# Links to dashboards and search.
resource "deed_integration" "grafana" {
  name    = "grafana"
  adapter = "grafana"
  config = jsonencode({
    url         = "https://grafana.example.com"
    allow_cidrs = ["192.168.0.7/32"]
  })
  secrets_wo         = { token = var.grafana_token }
  secrets_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `adapter` (String) Adapter: `prometheus`, `loki`, `grafana`, `natsmon` or `opensearch`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Unique name; bindings refer to the integration by name or ID.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `config` (String) Adapter configuration as a JSON object string (use `jsonencode`), validated by Deed against the adapter's schema: for example `url`, `tenant`, `allow_cidrs`, `insecure_http`, `timeout_seconds`. Secret fields do not belong here: put them in `secrets_wo`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether bindings may query it (default `true`).
- `secrets_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only credentials keyed by the adapter's secret fields (`token`, or `username` and `password`; OpenSearch also `api_key`). Sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes; never stored in state. When the version changes and this is unset, the stored credentials are cleared.
- `secrets_wo_version` (Number) Change this to send `secrets_wo` again (rotation).

### Read-Only

- `has_secrets` (Boolean) Whether Deed stores credentials for the integration.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import deed_integration.prometheus prometheus # name or ID
```
